subject: living manta-shaped cloak
picture: A huge empty cloak hangs flat against a dungeon wall like a manta ray pressed to stone. The cloth is one wide diamond shape. Two round eyes and a small mouth sit on the cloth. One long thin tail hangs from the bottom point. The side flaps hang empty like unused sleeves. Nobody is inside it. No hanger, no feet, no extra tails. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
